about: Call 11 (DR-278 (b)): each image stage whose alt does not carry every word its hidden picture holds, measured by script on a strict build of the fix pass snapshot (17:52 UTC, November 16, 2026). A word is a run of letters and digits, case folded; words under an inner aria-hidden, in style, script or defs, or under a hidden attribute are left out; inner aria-label names are counted. Text that CSS alone hides is counted, since the scan reads markup, not the rendered page.
